target.title: ProxyFix: use the original client address
target.description: Behind several proxies, X-Forwarded-For lists every hop. Use the first entry, which is the original client, instead of counting from the right. Also simplifies the host:port split for X-Forwarded-Host.

text:
Investigate this suspected problem.

Suspect S1: IPv6 address without port incorrectly split by colon
Category: correctness
Location: src/werkzeug/middleware/proxy_fix.py lines 164-165 (new version)
Suspected problem: Removing the check for ']' when splitting an IPv6 address in x_host means an IPv6 address without a port (e.g. [2001:db8::1]) will be incorrectly split on the internal colons by rsplit(':', 1), corrupting SERVER_NAME and SERVER_PORT.
What would confirm or refute it: Check existing unit tests for ProxyFix with IPv6 hosts in tests/test_middleware/test_proxy_fix.py to see how IPv6 host headers are tested.

The planner's summary of the pull request: ProxyFix now takes the first entry from X-Forwarded-For instead of counting from the right, and simplifies IPv6 host-port parsing for X-Forwarded-Host.

arguments.claim: Removing the check for ']' when parsing an IPv6 address in X-Forwarded-Host causes an IPv6 address without a port (such as [2001:db8::a]) to be incorrectly split on its internal colons by rsplit(':', 1), corrupting SERVER_NAME and SERVER_PORT.
arguments.explanation: In ProxyFix, when x_host contains an IPv6 address without a port (e.g., '[2001:db8::a]'), the check `if ":" in x_host and not x_host.endswith("]")` was changed to simply `if ":" in x_host`. Because IPv6 addresses contain colons internally, `x_host.rsplit(":", 1)` splits the address itself rather than separating a host from a port, corrupting `SERVER_NAME` and `SERVER_PORT`.
arguments.suggested_fix: Restore the check for ']' or ensure bracketed IPv6 addresses are handled correctly before splitting by colon.

evidence.note: ProxyFix splits x_host on ':' without checking if it is a bracketed IPv6 address without a port
Test case expects ipv6 host without port to parse correctly as url root
